_about: Numbers for the report. Write {{count:key}} in any part or fragment and build.mjs fills it from this file (dots reach into groups: {{count:seed.claims}}). A key is a plain value or an object {value, source, pending}. source says which file the figure comes from. pending: true marks a figure that is not measured yet: the build warns about it, and --strict refuses to build while a pending key is used. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
